name: fast-glob
description: Minimal, security-hardened drop-in shim for fast-glob. Vendored to break the fast-glob -> micromatch -> braces dependency chain (braces has no patched release for GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm). Implements the subset of the API used by @next/eslint-plugin-next. Wire it up with an npm override.
